The issuer exhibits solid profitability with an operating margin of 9% and a net income of 665M, backed by a large asset base of 71.5B and substantial retained earnings of 36.4B. However, the credit profile is constrained by a very weak liquidity position, highlighted by a current ratio of 0.59 (current liabilities exceed current assets by nearly 9B) and a relatively high leverage ratio (total liabilities to equity of approximately 1.76). These factors indicate a moderate payment capacity with notable short-term refinancing risks, typical of an investment-grade issuer at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
